geographicScope.description: Designated federal capital; Parliament in Melbourne, and construction/department transfer gradual.

evidence.note: Naming12March1913 designated Canberra national capital; Melbourne remained parliamentary seat until relocation. Full years1914–1926 preserve distinction, not an assertion government physically already relocated.
